paragraphs.text: Usage-driven tuning advice for DeepSeek Harness: per-module analysis of your own sessions, one-click
per-model compaction thresholds · 按真实用量给 DSH 逐项调优建议
# dsh-tuner
English · 中文
**Tuning advice for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) based on your own sessions, module by module, with one-cl
ick compaction thresholds.**
There is no single best configuration: long sessions and quick questions, a 500k-window model and a
1M-window model each have their own sweet spot. dsh-tuner reads only the sessions on your machine an
d answers three questions per module: how things are now, whether to change anything, and what to ch
hree questions per module: how things are now, whether to change anything, and what to change it to.
> The panel UI is in Chinese.
## Modules
| Module | Question it answers | Outcome |
| Compaction policy | At what ratio should each model compact? Will it compact again right after (a
"treadmill")? | **One click** writes `compaction-basic.modelPolicies` into the active agent preset |
| Compaction health | How did real compactions go: failures and causes, time spent? Runs are judged
against the threshold in force at the time, so fixed problems stay separate from current ones | Con

fig snippet |
| Cache | Cache hit ratio and request gaps; is a cache keep-warm worth it? | Verdict |
| Model side | Retries by cause, reasoning effort, generation speed per model; are idle timeouts co

ncentrated at the highest effort? | Advice (effort is set in the model picker) |
| Tools | Calls, fa
ilure causes and output size per tool; hook overhead | Copyable AGENTS.md sentences |
The overview fits every module on one screen; click a card for the details: conclusions, data tables
, replay breakdown and definitions. Follows the app's light and dark themes.
Dark theme
## Install
Verified on DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 (the desktop app's `desktop` profile and `dsh web`).
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The desktop app's `desktop` profile only accepts the CLI bundled with the app (a `dsh` on your PATH
refuses with `managed exclusively by the Electron application`). On macOS:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Quit the app before installing and reopen it afterwards; in `dsh web`, reload the page. A 「调优 v0.5」
(Tuner) entry appears in the sidebar.
Uninstall with `dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-tuner`. Thresholds already written into a
preset stay there; click 「恢复 preset 默认」 (restore preset defaults) in the panel first if you want the
re; click 「恢复 preset 默认」 (restore preset defaults) in the panel first if you want the defaults back.
## Use

1. Open 「调优」 in the sidebar and pick a window (last 7 / 14 / 30 days).
2. Scan the overview: orange

= worth changing, blue = waiting for data, green = fine.
3. Open the compaction policy card and chec

k each model's replay table; click 「应用按模型建议」 (apply per-model advice) if you agree.
4. Written setti

ngs apply to **new sessions only**; run `/compact` or reopen sessions that are already open.
5. Rest
ore the preset defaults at any time.
Without the UI, the `/tuner` slash command prints the same report as text.
## What it changes
- **Read-only by default**: it reads this profile's sessions through DSH's session query service and

computes everything locally. No model calls, no network, nothing uploaded.
- **Writes only when you
click apply**: one row, `compaction-basic` of the default agent preset, in the profile's `cordis.pa
tch.yml`. It reads the value back and rolls back if it did not land. Your other changes to the prese

t are kept.
- **At startup**: if a preset override names rows the running DSH no longer ships (commo
n after an upgrade, and fatal for that mode's sessions), it rebuilds that override on the new defaul

ts, keeping the rows you changed, and the panel says which rows were dropped or added.
- **Never tou
ches**: model choice, reasoning effort, AGENTS.md, hook configuration. Those get advice and copyable
el choice, reasoning effort, AGENTS.md, hook configuration. Those get advice and copyable text only.
## Limitations
- The replay is an estimate, not a re-run: changes in summary quality are not modelled, and the post

-compaction floor is a measured median, so an unusually large turn may land higher.
- Subagent sessi
ons are excluded; forks are included (shared history counted once); sessions with fewer than 3 reque

sts are skipped.
- A preset override is a complete config (DSH semantics): when upstream only change

s the defaults of existing rows, the override does not follow.
- A cache keep-warm is not something
this plugin provides; it only tells you whether one is worth installing.
## How it works
How the advice is computed and why preset overrides get rebuilt: docs/DESIGN.zh.md (Chinese). Releas
e history: CHANGELOG.md.
## Feedback
Please open an issue.
